userId.description: The unique user identifier matching Firebase Auth UID

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent login

UserInquiry.title: UserInquiry
UserInquiry.description: A Jauhari AI epistemological inquiry record saved for a user

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this inquiry

question.description: The inquiry prompt submitted by user

isFallback.description: Whether answer came from local manifesto corpus fallback

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when the inquiry occurred

isSaved.description: Whether this inquiry is preserved in the scholar's permanent Saved Inquiries archive

savedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the inquiry was bookmarked or saved

savedToDrive.description: Whether this inquiry has been exported to Google Drive

driveFileId.description: Google Drive File ID if exported

driveFileUrl.description: Google Drive Web View link if exported

driveFileName.description: Name of the file in Google Drive

/users/{userId}/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: User inquiry records (10 most recent inquiries + unlimited permanent saved inquiries archive)
